name: webzonebw-er-studio
description: WEBZONEBW ER Studio - Extended Reality Camera Experience

scripts.test:health: curl http://localhost:3000/api/health || echo 'Port 3000 not available, trying fallback ports...' && curl http://localhost:3001/api/health && curl http://localhost:3002/api/health && curl http://localhost:3003/api/health && curl http://localhost:8080/api/health && curl http://localhost:8081/api/health
scripts.test:metrics: curl http://localhost:3000/api/metrics || echo 'Port 3000 not available, trying fallback ports...' && curl http://localhost:3001/api/metrics && curl http://localhost:3002/api/metrics && curl http://localhost:3003/api/metrics && curl http://localhost:8080/api/metrics && curl http://localhost:8081/api/metrics
scripts.port:check: node -e "const net = require('net'); net.connect({host: 'localhost', port: 3000}, () => console.log('Port 3000 is available')).on('error', () => console.log('Port 3000 is in use'));"
scripts.port:clean: taskkill /F /IM node.exe /T && echo 'All Node.js processes killed'

author: Sameer Chouhan
